subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: What trusted preview-widget boundary should OpenClaw accept for URL embeds now, and what must remain separate for dev-server process ownership and browser-backed inspection?
rationale: The request adds a first-party dashboard/browser surface and later crosses process and inspection boundaries that automation cannot approve as product policy.

options.title: Phase-One Preview Only
options.body: Accept a narrow URL embed/reload/viewport widget after the open PR is fixed, proven, and restacked, while deferring process and browser-inspection capabilities.

options.title: Wait For Dashboard Substrate
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until the broader dashboard stack has landed or been replaced by maintainer-owned APIs.

options.title: Decline Bundled Preview For Now
options.body: Reject the bundled trusted preview direction until maintainers decide whether this belongs outside core or behind a different plugin/API seam.

recommendation.title: Phase-One Preview Only
recommendation.body: Accept a narrow URL embed/reload/viewport widget after the open PR is fixed, proven, and restacked, while deferring process and browser-inspection capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a product and security boundary decision, and @steipete is both the lead maintainer and the current-main owner signal for the relevant Control UI/plugin-tab code.
